title: Scorecard
description: Is each service in good shape? Four parts per service, each with its own status: duties, availability, documentation and protection need. Attention needed when any part needs attention – there is no weighting.
emptyHint: Services that are not archived are listed here with their scorecard.

noData.noSource: No data: the Gatus platform has no metrics mode, or it is turned off.
noData.uptimesOff: No data: Steward does not read Gatus' uptime figures for this platform. Turn on “Also read Gatus' uptime figures” in its metrics mode.
noData.stale: No data: Gatus' uptime figures were last read more than 3 hours ago.
noData.noEndpoint: No data: Gatus does not report this endpoint any more.
noData.noValue: No data: Gatus reported no value for a window.

form.platformHint: Gatus platforms with metrics mode that you may see.
form.noSources: No Gatus platform with metrics mode
form.uptimesOff: Steward does not read Gatus' uptime figures for this platform yet: the objective shows “no data” until “Also read Gatus' uptime figures” is on in its metrics mode.
form.name: Name
form.targetsHint: Minimum uptime in percent, as Gatus reports it, for each window you want to judge. Leave a window empty to ignore it.
form.targetsRequired: Set a target for at least one window.
form.notify: Send a message when it falls below target
form.notifyHint: To the service owners (administrators when it has none), once per breach.
form.platformHidden: You may not see the Gatus platform of this objective. You can change its name and targets; the endpoint stays.

objectives.title: Availability objectives
objectives.hint: Values are Gatus' own uptime figures, read once an hour. Steward keeps an hourly sample for 90 days.
objectives.historySummary_one: {{count}} hourly sample in the last 30 days, {{below}} below target, breaches: {{breaches}} – the line shows {{window}}
objectives.historySummary_other: {{count}} hourly samples in the last 30 days, {{below}} below target, breaches: {{breaches}} – the line shows {{window}}
objectives.archiveConfirm: Archive the objective “{{name}}”? It is no longer sampled; its samples and breaches stay, and it still counts on the scorecard with its last status until its longest window has passed.

duties.mandatory: Mandatory: {{met}} of {{total}} met, {{open}} open, {{notMet}} not met
duties.recommended: Recommended: {{met}} of {{total}} met, {{open}} open, {{notMet}} not met
duties.archived_one: {{count}} duty archived this period – it counts until the period ends
duties.archived_other: {{count}} duties archived this period – they count until the period ends

availability.summary: {{met}} of {{total}} met · {{below}} below target · {{noData}} without data
availability.tooLong: {{name}}: no data for more than 24 hours

documentation.summary: {{released}} of {{documents}} documents released · {{overdue}} reviews overdue · {{dueSoon}} due soon

protection.noApplications: Not rated: the service has no applications.
protection.scaleInvalid: The CIA scale is not valid: the protection need cannot be determined.

history.none: No stored days yet. Steward stores the scorecard once a day.
history.summary_one: Last {{count}} stored day: {{attention}} with attention needed.
history.summary_other: Last {{count}} stored days: {{attention}} with attention needed.

trend.title: Trend (stored days)
trend.none: No stored days yet. Steward stores the scorecard of every service once a day.
trend.summary: From {{from}} to {{to}}: {{first}} → {{last}} of {{services}} services needed attention.

rules.title: Expected documents
rules.hint: Applications rated at least the given level in a dimension should have a released document of the type (applying to the application, or linked to the service). The list starts empty.
rules.invalid: Not applied: type or level no longer exists
